collection_profile.timing_notes: Exclusive per-thread CPU; overlapping wall times cannot be summed into job wall percentages. Persistent native-runtime worker CPU is measured separately from Linux /proc counters (usually 10 ms resolution). Startup and warmup excluded; no PPO updates. cProfile is used only for a separate call-count diagnostic, never CPU or wall-time attribution.

runs.notes: Single-thread replay against the pinned release rlib. Stage timings exclude trace IO, checksum verification, FFI string copying and Python. They are separate measurements, not additive to live collector timings.

feature_path_validation.description: Exact SHA-256 comparison of every encoded feature array and selected action index; excludes floating-point recurrent outputs/value/log-probability predictions. Trusted local trajectory files only.
